503:t_014:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「I...! If it protects the world, I'm prepared to take on any disgrace!」

503:t_016:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't let you go, $$ヒイロ$$!」

503:t_017:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That guy! He's pushing it way too far!」

503:t_017:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's far enough, $$ヒイロ$$. And you too, $c.」

503:t_017:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you want $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$ released, come with me.」

503:t_017:5.en:
$$五飛$$
「Are you telling us to surrender to $$クロノ$$?」

503:t_017:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「That is how we protect the world.」

503:t_017:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「I told you, $$バナージ$$. That I have resolve.」

503:t_017:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「For that, I'll use any means, even if they call me a coward.」

503:t_017:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$... After taking us in, what does $$クロノ$$ intend to do?」

503:t_017:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「First, we crush $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

503:t_017:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ intends to take that position by getting hold of $$ラプラスの箱$$... in other words, $$クロノ$$'s doctrine.」

503:t_017:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「But that cannot be allowed. $$クロノ$$ does not acknowledge the existence of Spacenoids.」

503:t_017:15.en:
$$キラ$$
「Wake up, Ensign $$リディ$$! Aren't people like that exactly who we've been fighting?」

503:t_017:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「Back then, I knew nothing... But now it's different...」

503:t_017:17.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have touched the truth. And this $$バンシィ$$ is the proof.」

503:t_017:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What on earth are you saying, Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

503:t_017:19.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have no intention of talking with you any further. Come with me, $c.」

503:t_017:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you refuse, I will kill $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$.」

503:t_017:21.en:
$$ノイン$$
「What kind of man are you...!」

503:t_017:25.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$... I'm going to kill you.」

503:t_019:2.en:
$$リディ$$

503:t_019:3.en:

503:t_020:1.en:

503:t_022:0.en:

503:t_022:3.en:

503:t_022:4.en:

503:t_022:5.en:
$$リディ$$

503:t_023:1.en:

「Shoot, $$ヒイロ$$! Come and kill me!」

503:t_024:0.en:

503:t_024:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「But even so, $$ヒイロ$$ won't stop.」

503:t_024:2.en:

503:t_024:3.en:
